## Invitations

A total of 455 invitations were issued for the outreach activity. Attendance was 30, representing a rate of 6.6 per cent. The figures provide a concise summary of the response to the invitation process and indicate the number of people who attended in relation to those invited.

The invitation arrangements were supported by direct communication. SMS messages were sent to 392 invitees. This provided an additional channel for sharing information about the outreach activity and supporting awareness among those who had received an invitation.

## Contact

Reminders went to 0 invitees. No reminder messages were therefore recorded as part of the contact activity.

Van days were kept where roads allowed. This approach supported the continuation of outreach contact in locations accessible by road, while recognising the practical limits created by local road conditions. The available contact activity consisted of the SMS communication and the outreach visits that could proceed.

Prepared by G. Evans.
